From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: POC/Trial planning: success criteria & RACI (AcmeHealth)

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation and appreciate the clarity on what success looks like for Acme. Below is a concise recap and the next steps we discussed so we can align on owners and timelines. Please reply with any updates or confirm and I'll proceed to schedule the kick-off.

Quick recap / goals for the 4-week POC
- Primary success criteria (what you can measure):
  1) 95th percentile inference latency <= 220ms for clinical search queries (avg length ~250 tokens)
  2) End-to-end cost not to exceed $0.12 per 1k tokens (target) during evaluation
  3) Zero data exfiltration: model runs within VPC / no logs persisted beyond retention window
  4) Qualitative: triage accuracy for top-3 clinical intents > 88% on your test set

Evaluation plan (what we will deliver):
- Week 0: Kick-off, dataset handoff (anonymized sample), infra checklist
- Week 1: Baseline deployment (hosted vs dedicated perf comparison), initial latency/cost baseline
- Week 2: Integrations + security review, run evaluation prompts against baseline
- Week 3: Tuning (batching/quantization suggestions), final eval run, collect feedback
- Week 4: Wrap-up, success criteria review, recommended configuration and next steps

Proposed RACI / stakeholder mapping (please confirm or update):
- Acme — App owner / evaluation lead (responsible): Emily Zhang (Product)
- Acme — Procurement point of contact: Tom Rivera (Procurement)
- Redwood — Sales / AM (account lead): Marissa Cole (Account Executive) — Responsible for commercial coordination and scheduling
- Redwood — Solutions / Infrastructure lead: Dev Patel (Solutions Engineer) — Responsible for infra setup, deployment, runbooks
- Redwood — Security reviewer: Rishi Malhotra (Security) — Responsible for SOC2 checklist, network/KMS guidance
- Redwood — Customer Success: Neha Kapoor — Success criteria validation and onboarding checklist

Open items / asks for Acme before kick-off:
1) Confirm the two Acme contacts above and the internal App owner we should work with on data/test-set access.
2) Provide anonymized sample dataset (S3/Share link) or confirm we should use synthetic data (deadline: 2026-11-20).
3) Procurement questionnaire: I've attached a draft for your team to review (Acme_procurement_questionnaire.pdf).

Attachments: Acme_procurement_questionnaire.pdf (draft)

Next steps
- Emily/Tom: confirm owners + dataset by 2026-11-20
- I'll send a calendar invite for a 30–45m kick-off the week of 2026-11-23 once owners are confirmed

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.


Marissa Cole
